headline: Japanese Market Notably Lower
summary: The Japanese stock market traded notably lower on Tuesday, snapping a three-session winning streak. The Nikkei 225 fell well below the 64,750 level, with weakness in automakers and technology stocks.
why: The Nikkei 225 is Japan's benchmark index of major listed companies, and automakers and chip-related stocks carry large weight in it.

impacts.name: Nikkei 225
impacts.why: The benchmark index is reported trading notably lower on the day.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Weakness in index heavyweights, automakers, and technology stocks pushed the Nikkei lower after three sessions of gains.
